sample.question:
The railway is directed from left to right. At a purple switch station, an advancing train follows the currently selected orange branch. A toggle command flips that switch; advance moves one station; hold does not move.
Starting T1 at A, execute these dispatcher commands in order: advance, toggle S1, advance, advance, toggle S2, advance, advance, toggle S3, advance. Where does T1 finish?
A. B
B. C
C. D
D. E
E. J
F. A

T1 finishes at J, so the answer is E.
